column1: # *** GONZALEZ LERENA - A COMPOUND BRANCH THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER SWEPT. 20 September 2026. ***
# Row 153 existed only because a false positive turned one up: a full-text search for
# 'Juan Carlos Lerena' matched ACROSS the compound 'Juan Carlos GONZALEZ LERENA'.
# *** The variant that produced a false positive turned out to hide a whole family. ***

column2: Surname *** 'Gonzalez Lerena' exact: 52 records ***, mostly Uruguay, some Mexico (Coahuila).
column3: *** Neither of this archive's two compound files held the form at all ***, so 52 records sat outside every sweep ever run. *** Compound surnames are not a curiosity here - they are where this surname hides. ***

column1: *** THE MATRIARCH, AND SHE IS NEW ***
column2: *** ESTEFANIA LERENA, married SERVANDO GONZALEZ. *** Twenty-eight records name her. Children traced so far: *** Servando Cecilio (1854-1911, Montevideo), Leopoldo, Francisco, Cesarea (chr. 30 April 1872, San Jose), Maria Bernarda, and Esperanza. ***
column3: *** A Lerena woman with at least six children, wholly absent from this archive. *** *** She is NOT attached to Sancho's line by anything and is recorded unplaced. *** The name Estefania does not appear anywhere in this register.

column1: *** IT REACHES COLONIA - WHICH IS ROW 156 ***
column2: *** Maria Bernarda Gonzalez Lerena, marriage registration 1931, CAMPANA, COLONIA. *** The family otherwise sits in San Jose and Montevideo.
column3: *** Row 156 asks who the 189 Lerena records of Colonia are, and part of the answer is: they are not all called Lerena. *** *** A department counted by exact surname will under-count a compound family and then be reported as thin. *** Colonia was measured that way.

column1: *** AND IT CLOSES THE FALSE POSITIVE PROPERLY ***
column2: *** Juan Carlos Gonzalez Lerena, born 1899 ***, married *** 9 November 1922 at Montevideo *** to *** Concepcion Petrona Urbano Orio ***; parents *** Leopoldo Gonzalez Lerena and Maria Guillerma Giuria. ***
column3: *** The man from the 1920 dispensation is now fully identified, and he is Estefania's grandson. *** Born 1899, so *** seventeen years after Pablo Armando ***. *** Not ours, and now demonstrably not ours rather than merely improbably so. ***
